nodes.name: Browser
nodes.description: Client-side application shell, routing, state, and UI components

nodes.name: App Shell
nodes.description: Root layout with QueryClientProvider, theme init, toast provider, and error boundary. Creates a single QueryClient instance per session, applies dark mode class on mount via useThemeStore.getState(), wraps all routes in QueryClientProvider and renders the Sonner Toaster.

nodes.name: Root Layout
nodes.description: SSR layout that creates a server-side QueryClient, prefetches categories via categoriesQueryOptions, dehydrates the cache, and passes it to HydrationBoundary. Renders Header and an Outlet for child routes.

nodes.name: Header
nodes.description: Sticky top bar with three sections: NavMenu (left, sheet drawer with category links from useCategoriesQuery), Logo (center), Cart drawer + ThemeToggle (right). Closes nav drawer automatically on navigation via useNavigation() state.

nodes.name: Home Page
nodes.description: SSR loader fetches categories then prefetches first page of category sections (4 categories with 4 products each, plus an artificial 800ms delay). Client hydrates from dehydrated state. IntersectionObserver (react-intersection-observer) triggers fetchNextPage when sentinel div enters viewport. Each CategorySection uses useCartStore to get addItem for ProductCards.

nodes.name: Products Page
nodes.description: SSR loader prefetches first page (limit=8) via productsInfiniteQueryOptions with optional category param. Client hydrates grid from cache. useCartStore provides addItem callback. Manual 'Load More' button calls fetchNextPage(). Pagination uses skip/limit: getNextPageParam calculates next skip value, stops when skip+products.length >= total.

nodes.name: Checkout Page
nodes.description: clientLoader guards empty cart (redirects to /products). Renders OrderSummary with items, subtotal, 20% VAT, total from useCartStore(). Form with ShippingForm and PaymentForm sub-components. clientAction awaits 1s setTimeout (simulated payment), calls cart.clear(), sets successfulOrder=true, shows toast, and redirects to /success. Submit button shows spinner via useNavigation() submitting state.

nodes.name: Success Page
nodes.description: clientLoader reads useCartStore.getState().successfulOrder -- if false, redirects to /products. If true, resets the flag to false immediately. Renders CheckCircle icon, hardcoded order number #134145, and triggers JSConfetti on mount (cleaned up on unmount via clearCanvas).

nodes.name: Cart Drawer
nodes.description: Radix Sheet overlay triggered by shopping cart icon button in header. Shows badge with cartItems.length. Lists CartItem components with increment/decrement/remove controls wired to useCartStore actions. Footer shows total and Checkout link to /checkout. Empty state component when cart is empty.

nodes.name: Product Card
nodes.description: Stateless presentational component receiving id, images, title, price, and onAddToCart callback. Displays first image with hover scale animation, title (truncated), formatted price, and full-width 'Add to cart' button. Calls onAddToCart with {id, images, title, price} then triggers toast.success('Product added to cart') via Sonner.

nodes.name: Client State
nodes.description: Zustand stores and TanStack Query caches managing all client-side data

nodes.name: Cart Store
nodes.description: Zustand store with persist middleware (localStorage key: 'cart-storage'). State: items (CartItem[]), total (number), successfulOrder (boolean). Actions: addItem (upserts by product.id, recalculates total via reduce), removeItem (filters out), incrementItem/decrementItem (map + filter for zero-count removal), clear (resets items and total). Total is eagerly recomputed on every mutation via reduce over items.

nodes.name: Theme Store
nodes.description: Zustand store with persist middleware (localStorage key: 'theme-storage'). State: theme ('dark' | 'light' | 'system'). Action: setTheme -- removes both light/dark classes from document.documentElement, resolves 'system' via window.matchMedia('prefers-color-scheme: dark'), adds resolved class. Default: 'system'.

nodes.name: Categories Query
nodes.description: TanStack Query hook with queryKey ['categories']. queryFn calls api.get('products/categories').json() returning Category[]. Used as both a standalone query (useCategoriesQuery) and as query options object (categoriesQueryOptions) for SSR prefetching in root-layout loader.

nodes.name: Category Sections Query
nodes.description: TanStack infinite query with queryKey ['category-sections']. Pages of 4 categories each. queryFn slices categories array by pageParam, fires parallel Promise.all with 800ms artificial delay + one api.get per category slug (limit=4 products, select=title,images,price,id). getNextPageParam returns null when all categories consumed. Depends on categories being fetched first (enabled: !!categories).

nodes.name: Products Query
nodes.description: TanStack infinite query with queryKey ['products', category]. queryFn calls api.get with limit=8 and skip=pageParam. Response includes total, skip, limit for pagination math. getNextPageParam: if skip + products.length >= total return null, else skip + limit. Optional category slug appended to URL path.

nodes.name: Data Access
nodes.description: HTTP client layer connecting the frontend to external APIs

nodes.name: API Client
nodes.description: Single ky instance created with ky.create({ prefixUrl: 'https://dummyjson.com' }). No timeout, retry, or error interceptor configuration -- uses ky defaults (no timeout, ky retries on 408/413/429/500-599 twice by default).

nodes.name: External
nodes.description: External APIs and services

nodes.name: DummyJSON Product API
nodes.description: Public REST API at dummyjson.com providing product catalog data. Endpoints used: GET /products/categories (all categories), GET /products/category/:slug (products by category), GET /products (all products). Supports pagination via limit/skip query params and field selection via select param.

state.name: Cart Store (localStorage)
state.description: Shopping cart items with product data ({id, title, price, images}) and quantities, computed total, successfulOrder flag

writers.via: onAddToCart callback from products-page and home-page/CategorySection

state.name: TanStack Query Cache
state.description: In-memory cache holding: ['categories'] (Category[]), ['category-sections'] (infinite pages of 4 category product groups), ['products', category?] (infinite pages of 8 products)

readers.mechanism: SSR prefetchQuery populates cache for HydrationBoundary
NavMenu uses useCategoriesQuery for category nav links

state.name: SSR Dehydrated State
state.description: Server-prefetched query results serialized into HTML as JSON for client hydration. Each route with a loader creates a separate QueryClient, prefetches, and dehydrates.

readers.mechanism: HydrationBoundary rehydrates categories into client QueryClient
HydrationBoundary rehydrates category-sections into client QueryClient
HydrationBoundary rehydrates products into client QueryClient

writers.mechanism: loader dehydrates QueryClient with prefetched categories
loader dehydrates QueryClient with prefetched categories + category-sections
loader dehydrates QueryClient with prefetched products

failure_modes.trigger: DummyJSON API becomes unreachable or returns 5xx
failure_modes.impact: Entire catalog is unavailable. Cart and checkout still work for previously-added items since cart-store is in localStorage and checkout uses only client-side state.

cascade.effect: ky throws HTTPError (5xx) or TypeError (network failure). ky retries 5xx twice by default before failing.
queryFn throws. TanStack Query retries 3 times (default) with exponential backoff. Query enters error state after all retries exhausted.

SSR loader awaits prefetchQuery which swallows errors (prefetch never throws). However, the home-page loader uses fetchQuery which DOES throw. If the root-layout loader completes but subsequent child loader fails, React Router ErrorBoundary in root.tsx catches it.

SSR loader calls fetchQuery(categoriesQueryOptions) which throws on failure. Entire page falls to ErrorBoundary. If SSR succeeds but client-side fetchNextPage fails, infinite scroll stops and isFetching remains true showing skeleton indefinitely.
SSR loader prefetchInfiniteQuery swallows error. Client hydrates with empty cache, useProductsInfiniteQuery retries. If all retries fail, no products render and hasNextPage is undefined.
NavMenu's useCategoriesQuery enters error state. Category links do not render. Navigation drawer shows only 'All Products' link.

detection: TanStack Query error states surface in UI (no explicit error UI exists -- components just render empty)
SSR loader throws trigger React Router ErrorBoundary showing 'Oops! An unexpected error occurred.' with stack trace in DEV
ky logs network errors to console
recovery: ky retries 5xx responses twice (built-in default, not explicitly configured)
TanStack Query retries failed queries 3 times with exponential backoff
User can manually refresh the page to re-trigger SSR loaders
Cart-based flows (checkout, success) are unaffected since they use only localStorage state

failure_modes.trigger: localStorage is blocked (private browsing in some browsers, storage quota exceeded, or disabled by user/policy)
failure_modes.impact: Cart and theme reset on page reload. Shopping experience works within a single session. Checkout flow works normally since it reads from in-memory Zustand state.

cascade.effect: Zustand persist middleware wraps localStorage access in try/catch. getItem returns null, setItem silently fails. Store operates in memory-only mode. Cart works normally within the session but items/total/successfulOrder are lost on refresh.
Same persist behavior. Theme reverts to 'system' default on every page load. setTheme still works within session (directly manipulates DOM classList).
useEffect reads useThemeStore.getState().theme which returns 'system' (default) instead of persisted preference. Dark class not applied if user previously chose dark.

detection: No detection mechanism exists. Zustand persist silently degrades.
User notices cart is empty after refresh (only observable symptom)
recovery: Zustand persist has built-in try/catch; automatic fallback to in-memory operation
No manual intervention needed for in-session use

failure_modes.trigger: Server-rendered HTML diverges from client hydration. Concrete cause: app-shell's useEffect adds 'dark' class to documentElement on mount, but SSR renders without it since useThemeStore.getState() runs only client-side in useEffect.
failure_modes.impact: Brief visual flicker on initial load as theme class is applied post-hydration. Content is correct; only styling flashes.

cascade.effect: React 19 logs hydration mismatch warning to console. The documentElement className differs between server ('') and client ('dark'). Visible as a flash of light theme before dark mode applies.
Dehydrated query state is stable (same data). No functional mismatch -- only the theme class causes visual inconsistency.

detection: React hydration mismatch console warnings in browser DevTools
Visual flash of unstyled/wrong-themed content (FOUC) observable by users
recovery: Client reconciliation corrects the DOM automatically within one frame
Proper fix would be to inject theme class in the SSR HTML template or use a blocking script

failure_modes.trigger: DummyJSON API responds slowly (>3s). No explicit timeout is configured on the ky client.
failure_modes.impact: Page load is slow. SSR blocks until API responds since loaders await API calls. TTFB increases 1:1 with API latency. Category sections query has an additional 800ms artificial delay per page.

cascade.effect: ky has no timeout configured (ky.create only sets prefixUrl). Requests hang for as long as the underlying fetch takes. Browser/Node fetch has no default timeout.
SSR loader awaits prefetchQuery(categoriesQueryOptions). Server response is delayed by full API latency. TTFB increases proportionally.

SSR loader awaits fetchQuery (categories) then prefetchInfiniteQuery (4 category product fetches in parallel + 800ms artificial delay). Total SSR delay = categories fetch + max(4 product fetches, 800ms). Client-side infinite scroll shows CategorySectionSkeleton indefinitely while waiting.
SSR loader awaits prefetchInfiniteQuery. Delay = single products API call. Client-side 'Load More' shows ProductCardSkeleton array while waiting.

detection: Slow TTFB on server-rendered pages (measurable via browser DevTools Network tab or server-side metrics)
Prolonged skeleton states visible to user during client-side pagination
No alerting or monitoring configured in the application
recovery: No automatic recovery. No timeout, no circuit breaker, no fallback.
Depends entirely on DummyJSON API eventually responding
User can navigate away but cannot cancel in-flight SSR requests

data_flows.name: Home Page Load
data_flows.description: SSR prefetches categories and first page of category sections, client hydrates and infinite-scrolls additional pages
data_flows.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Shopper
    participant RR as React Router SSR
    participant RL as Root Layout Loader
    participant HL as Home Page Loader
    participant KY as ky (API Client)
    participant DJ as DummyJSON API
    participant HB as HydrationBoundary
    participant Home as Home Component
    participant IO as IntersectionObserver
    participant DOM as Browser DOM

    Shopper->>RR: GET /
    RR->>RL: Execute loader
    RL->>KY: prefetchQuery(categoriesQueryOptions)
    KY->>DJ: GET /products/categories
    DJ-->>KY: Category[]
    KY-->>RL: Cache populated
    RL-->>RR: {dehydratedState}
    RR->>HL: Execute loader
    HL->>KY: fetchQuery(categoriesQueryOptions)
    KY-->>HL: Category[] (from cache)
    HL->>KY: prefetchInfiniteQuery(page 0: 4 categories)
    KY->>DJ: GET /products/category/:slug x4 (parallel)
    DJ-->>KY: Products per category
    KY-->>HL: Cache populated
    HL-->>RR: {dehydratedState}
    RR-->>Shopper: SSR HTML with dehydrated query cache
    Shopper->>HB: Client hydration
    HB->>Home: Rehydrate query cache, render CategorySections
    Home->>DOM: Render category grids + sentinel div
    Shopper->>DOM: Scrolls down
    DOM->>IO: Sentinel enters viewport (inView=true)
    IO->>Home: useEffect triggers fetchNextPage()
    Home->>KY: Fetch next 4 categories with products
    KY->>DJ: GET /products/category/:slug x4 (parallel)
    DJ-->>KY: Next batch of products
    KY-->>Home: New page appended to infinite query
    Home->>DOM: Render new CategorySections below existing

steps.action: SSR loader creates QueryClient, calls prefetchQuery(categoriesQueryOptions)
ky.get('products/categories').json() fetches full category list
SSR loader creates separate QueryClient, fetchQuery gets categories, then prefetchInfiniteQuery loads page 0 (first 4 categories sliced from array)
Fires 4 parallel requests for category products
React Router serializes dehydrated QueryClient state into SSR HTML response
steps.data: JSON-serialized query cache embedded in HTML

steps.action: HydrationBoundary rehydrates query cache. Home component renders CategorySection for each category in pages[0].categoryProducts
react-intersection-observer's useInView detects sentinel div entering viewport. useEffect calls categorySections.fetchNextPage() when inView=true and not already fetching
steps.data: pageParam incremented to next batch of 4 categories

steps.action: New CategorySection components rendered below existing ones. Sentinel div moves to bottom. Process repeats until all categories exhausted (hasNextPage=false).
steps.data: Additional ProductCard components per new category

data_flows.name: Add to Cart
data_flows.description: Product is added to Zustand cart store, persisted to localStorage, cart badge updates, toast confirms
data_flows.trigger: Shopper clicks 'Add to cart' button on any ProductCard
data_flows.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Shopper
    participant PC as ProductCard
    participant CS as Cart Store (Zustand)
    participant LS as localStorage
    participant CD as Cart Drawer (Badge)
    participant Toast as Sonner Toaster
    participant DOM as Browser DOM

    Shopper->>PC: Click 'Add to cart' button
    PC->>PC: handleAddToCart() extracts {id, images, title, price}
    PC->>CS: onAddToCart(product) -> addItem(product)
    CS->>CS: Check if product.id exists in items[]
    alt Product already in cart
        CS->>CS: Map items: increment count for matching id
    else New product
        CS->>CS: Spread items + new {product, count: 1}
    end
    CS->>CS: Recalculate total via reduce(sum + price * count)
    CS->>CS: Zustand set({items, total}) triggers subscribers
    CS->>LS: Persist middleware: localStorage.setItem('cart-storage', JSON.stringify(state))
    CS-->>CD: Zustand subscription fires
    CD->>DOM: Re-render badge: cartItems.length
    PC->>Toast: toast.success('Product added to cart')
    Toast->>DOM: Render toast notification (auto-dismiss)

steps.action: handleAddToCart extracts {id, images, title, price} from props and calls onAddToCart(product) callback, then fires toast.success('Product added to cart')

addItem: finds existing item by product.id. If found, maps items to increment count. If new, appends {product, count: 1}. Recomputes total via reduce(sum + item.product.price * item.count, 0). Calls set() with new items and total.
Zustand persist middleware intercepts set(), serializes state to JSON, writes to localStorage under key 'cart-storage'
steps.data: JSON string of {state: {items, total, successfulOrder}, version: 0}

steps.action: Zustand subscription triggers re-render. Badge shows cartItems.length. If drawer is open, new/updated CartItem appears in list with correct count.
steps.data: items.length for badge, full items[] for list

steps.action: Sonner toast.success renders 'Product added to cart' notification that auto-dismisses

data_flows.name: Checkout Flow
data_flows.description: Shopper fills shipping and payment forms, submits; clientAction simulates payment, clears cart, sets success flag, redirects to success page with confetti
data_flows.trigger: Shopper clicks 'Checkout' link in cart drawer
data_flows.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Shopper
    participant CD as Cart Drawer
    participant RR as React Router
    participant CL as Checkout clientLoader
    participant CS as Cart Store (Zustand)
    participant CP as Checkout Page
    participant Form as HTML Form
    participant CA as Checkout clientAction
    participant LS as localStorage
    participant SL as Success clientLoader
    participant SP as Success Page
    participant Confetti as JSConfetti
    participant DOM as Browser DOM

    Shopper->>CD: Click 'Checkout' link
    CD->>RR: Navigate to /checkout
    RR->>CL: Execute clientLoader
    CL->>CS: getState().items.length
    alt Cart empty
        CL-->>RR: redirect('/products')
    else Cart has items
        CL-->>RR: null (proceed)
    end
    RR->>CP: Render Checkout component
    CP->>CS: useCartStore() subscribes to items, total
    CP->>DOM: Render OrderSummary (items, subtotal, 20% VAT, total)
    CP->>DOM: Render ShippingForm + PaymentForm
    Shopper->>Form: Fill shipping and payment details
    Shopper->>Form: Click 'Place Order' button
    Form->>RR: POST /checkout (client-side)
    RR->>CA: Execute clientAction
    CA->>CA: await setTimeout(1000ms) -- simulated payment
    CA->>CS: getState().clear() -> set({items: [], total: 0})
    CS->>LS: Persist: localStorage.setItem('cart-storage', ...)
    CA->>CS: setState({successfulOrder: true})
    CS->>LS: Persist: localStorage.setItem('cart-storage', ...)
    CA->>RR: redirect('/success')
    RR->>SL: Execute clientLoader
    SL->>CS: getState().successfulOrder
    SL->>CS: setState({successfulOrder: false})
    SL-->>RR: null (proceed)
    RR->>SP: Render Success component
    SP->>Confetti: new JSConfetti().addConfetti()
    Confetti->>DOM: Canvas confetti animation
    SP->>DOM: Render CheckCircle, order #134145, 'Continue Shopping' link

steps.action: Shopper clicks Checkout Link which navigates to /checkout via React Router
clientLoader reads useCartStore.getState().items.length. If 0, returns redirect('/products'). Otherwise returns null to proceed.
Checkout component calls useCartStore() to subscribe to full store. Reads items, total. Computes subtotal=total, vat=subtotal*0.2, grandTotal=subtotal+vat. Renders OrderSummary with item list.
ShippingForm and PaymentForm render inside a React Router Form (method='post'). Submit button disabled when navigation.state === 'submitting', shows Loader spinner.
steps.data: HTML form fields for shipping address and payment

steps.action: clientAction: awaits 1s setTimeout simulating payment processing. Then calls useCartStore.getState().clear() which sets items=[] and total=0. Then calls useCartStore.setState({successfulOrder: true}). Fires toast.success. Returns redirect('/success').
steps.data: Form submission triggers simulated payment flow

steps.action: clear() sets items=[] and total=0. Then successfulOrder set to true. Both mutations persisted to localStorage by Zustand persist middleware.

clientLoader reads useCartStore.getState().successfulOrder. If false, redirects to /products (prevents direct navigation). If true, immediately resets flag to false via setState({successfulOrder: false}).
useEffect creates new JSConfetti instance and calls addConfetti(). Cleanup calls clearCanvas(). Renders CheckCircle icon, hardcoded order number #134145, and 'Continue Shopping' link to /products.

data_flows.name: Product Listing Browse
data_flows.description: SSR prefetches first page, client hydrates product grid, shopper paginates with manual Load More button
data_flows.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Shopper
    participant RR as React Router SSR
    participant PL as Products Page Loader
    participant KY as ky (API Client)
    participant DJ as DummyJSON API
    participant HB as HydrationBoundary
    participant PP as Products Page Component
    participant CS as Cart Store
    participant PC as ProductCard
    participant Toast as Sonner Toaster
    participant DOM as Browser DOM

    Shopper->>RR: GET /products[/:category]
    RR->>PL: Execute loader({params: {category?}})
    PL->>KY: prefetchInfiniteQuery(productsInfiniteQueryOptions({category}))
    KY->>DJ: GET /products[/category/:slug]?select=title,images,price,id&limit=8&skip=0
    DJ-->>KY: {products[], total, limit, skip}
    KY-->>PL: Cache populated
    PL-->>RR: {dehydratedState, title}
    RR-->>Shopper: SSR HTML with product grid
    Shopper->>HB: Client hydration
    HB->>PP: Rehydrate query cache
    PP->>CS: useCartStore(state => state.addItem)
    PP->>DOM: Render CategoryBreadcrumb (if category) + product grid
    PP->>DOM: Render 'Load More' button (if hasNextPage)
    Shopper->>DOM: Click 'Load More'
    DOM->>PP: onClick -> fetchNextPage()
    PP->>KY: Fetch next page (skip = previous skip + limit)
    KY->>DJ: GET /products?limit=8&skip=8
    DJ-->>KY: Next page of products
    KY-->>PP: New page appended to infinite query
    PP->>DOM: Append new ProductCards to grid
    Shopper->>PC: Click 'Add to cart'
    PC->>CS: addItem(product)
    PC->>Toast: toast.success('Product added to cart')

steps.action: SSR loader extracts optional category from params. Creates QueryClient, calls prefetchInfiniteQuery with productsInfiniteQueryOptions({category}). Returns dehydrated state and title (fromSlugToTitle or 'All Products').
ky.get with path 'products' or 'products/category/:slug', select=title,images,price,id, limit=8, skip=pageParam

HydrationBoundary rehydrates. Categories component renders: CategoryBreadcrumb (if category), title, grid of ProductCards from pages.flatMap. useCartStore(state => state.addItem) passed as onAddToCart to each ProductCard.
steps.data: Product grid with id, images, title, price per card

steps.action: If hasNextPage is true, renders 'Load more' Button. onClick calls fetchNextPage(). getNextPageParam computes: if skip + products.length >= total -> null (done), else skip + limit. During fetch, 4 ProductCardSkeleton placeholders shown.
steps.data: Next skip value = previous skip + limit (8)

steps.action: New products page appended to infinite query data. Grid re-renders with all pages flattened. End-of-list message shown when hasNextPage becomes false.
steps.data: Cumulative Product[] across all fetched pages

data_flows.name: Theme Toggle
data_flows.description: User toggles between dark and light theme via header button; preference persisted to localStorage and applied to DOM
data_flows.trigger: Shopper clicks the theme toggle button in the header
data_flows.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Shopper
    participant TT as ThemeToggle Button
    participant TS as Theme Store (Zustand)
    participant DE as document.documentElement
    participant MM as window.matchMedia
    participant LS as localStorage
    participant DOM as Browser DOM

    Shopper->>TT: Click toggle button
    TT->>TS: Read current theme via useThemeStore()
    alt Current theme is 'dark'
        TT->>TS: setTheme('light')
    else Current theme is 'light' or 'system'
        TT->>TS: setTheme('dark')
    end
    TS->>DE: classList.remove('light', 'dark')
    alt Theme is 'system'
        TS->>MM: matchMedia('prefers-color-scheme: dark').matches
        MM-->>TS: boolean
        TS->>DE: classList.add(resolved theme)
    else Explicit theme
        TS->>DE: classList.add(theme)
    end
    TS->>TS: Zustand set({theme})
    TS->>LS: Persist: localStorage.setItem('theme-storage', JSON.stringify(state))
    DE-->>DOM: Tailwind dark: variants activate/deactivate
    DOM-->>Shopper: UI colors update immediately

steps.action: ThemeToggle component reads current theme via useThemeStore(). On click, calls setTheme('light') if current is 'dark', otherwise setTheme('dark'). Note: 'system' is treated as non-dark, so clicking from system goes to dark.
setTheme: removes both 'light' and 'dark' classes from document.documentElement. If 'system', queries matchMedia for OS preference. Adds resolved class. Calls Zustand set({theme}).
steps.data: CSS class on <html> element + stored preference

steps.action: Zustand persist middleware serializes {theme} to localStorage under key 'theme-storage'
On next page load, useEffect reads useThemeStore.getState().theme and applies 'dark' class if needed. This is the SSR->client bridge for theme.
ThemeToggle re-renders: Sun/Moon icons swap visibility via Tailwind dark: variant classes. Transition animations play.
